solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Black stuff covering bishop's pen

indicators.note: the black stuff wraps round the bishop, so one piece is set inside the other

parts.note: coal is the black stuff dug from a mine
RR stands for Right Reverend, a bishop's title

explanation.surface: Coal dust is smothering a clergyman's writing pen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pen' is a fountain pen in the surface but an animal enclosure in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A corral is an enclosure for livestock, just as a pen is.

clue.text: Accountant and graduate left small party

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant
BA is a Bachelor of Arts, a graduate

explanation.surface: Three people walked out of a small gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabal is a small group of plotters, a small faction or party.

clue.text: Rush outside recently having restored energy

indicators.note: the rush is placed around the other piece, so it sits outside it

parts.note: a reed is a rush, the waterside plant
fresh means newly or recently, as in fresh from school

explanation.surface: Someone hurries outdoors, newly invigorated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rush' reads as a verb, but it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: To be refreshed is to have had one's energy renewed.

clue.text: Row over time needed for descent

indicators.note: in a down clue the row sits above the time, so it is placed first

parts.note: a line is a row
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: An argument drags on about how long genealogy research takes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' suggests a quarrel but is a line.
explanation.definitionFit: Lineage is ancestry, one's line of descent.

clue.text: Breakfast food cooler?

definitions.meaning: oat cereal cooked in milk or water
cooler is slang for prison, and ... is British slang for time served in prison

explanation.walkthrough: 'Cooler' seems to mean something to chill hot oats, but it is prison slang; British readers know porridge as a jail term from the sitcom of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: The oat dish is a breakfast staple, and in British slang it also means a prison sentence.

clue.text: Remedy for a writer missing the point

definitions.text: Remedy for a writer missing the point

parts.words: Remedy for a writer missing the point
parts.note: the writer is a pencil whose lead has worn blunt, and the remedy is the gadget that puts a tip back on it

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests an author who missed the point of a story.
explanation.definitionFit: The small bladed device restores a sharp tip to a blunt writing implement.

clue.text: Harsh treatment of unseasoned wood

parts.note: raw means not seasoned or treated
deal is sawn pine or fir timber

explanation.surface: Being handed green timber is a raw bargain.
explanation.definitionFit: A raw deal is unfair or harsh handling of someone.

clue.text: In retrospect, we would decline a little liquid

indicators.note: looking back, so the contracted we would is read from right to left

parts.note: contracted to we'd
to drop is to decline or fall

explanation.surface: Looking back, we would refuse a small drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A dewdrop is a single small bead of moisture.

clue.text: Won't emend revised bequest

indicators.note: something revised is reworked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A will that has been rewritten will not be corrected again.
explanation.definitionFit: An endowment is money or property given or left to an institution.

clue.text: Scientist on holiday entering wine store

indicators.note: the holiday word goes into the wine store

parts.note: a bin is a rack or store for wine bottles
off means away from work

explanation.surface: A researcher on leave pops into the wine merchant's.
explanation.walkthrough: A wine bin is a storage rack in a cellar. Boffin is British slang for a scientist or expert.
explanation.definitionFit: Boffin is British informal for a scientist, especially a technical researcher.

clue.text: Having recently become member of a union

definitions.text: Having recently become member of a union

parts.words: Having recently become member of a union
parts.note: the union is a marriage rather than a trade union, so this is someone just married

explanation.walkthrough: 'Union' suggests a trade union; here it is marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone just married has newly joined a marital union.

clue.text: Men of letters, burning with irate rambling

parts.note: lit means alight or burning

indicators.note: rambling means wandering about, so the letters of irate wander out of order

explanation.surface: Writers fuming with angry rants.
explanation.definitionFit: The literati are learned, literary people.

clue.text: Could be worse, ringing about legal document

indicators.note: the rearranged letters encircle the abbreviation for about
signals that the following word could be rearranged into something else

parts.note: C stands for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Things could get worse when someone phones about a legal deed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Could be' makes ESROW from worse; 'ringing' puts C (circa) inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An escrow is a deed or bond held by a third party until a condition is met.

clue.text: Hard-hearted, without Biblical character?

parts.note: Ruth is the heroine of the Old Testament book named after her
the suffix less means without

explanation.surface: A cold person lacking any religious figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Being merciless and pitiless is to be hard-hearted.

clue.text: Fizzy beer left by beast — revolting

definitions.note: used as a noun, the act of revolting

indicators.note: fizzy drinks bubble and churn, so these letters are stirred up

parts.note: a lion is a beast

explanation.surface: Bubbly ale abandoned by an animal is disgusting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolting' looks like disgusting, but it means rising up. 'Fizzy' turns beer into REBE.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebellion is an uprising, the act of rising against authority.

clue.text: Sauce with food — it's red and goes on chops

definitions.text: it's red and goes on chops

parts.note: lip means cheek or sauce, insolent talk
a pie is a food

explanation.surface: Ketchup with your meal: red stuff to put on lamb chops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chops' is slang for lips, not cuts of meat. Lippie is informal for lipstick.
explanation.definitionFit: Lippie is slang for lipstick, often red and applied to the mouth.

clue.text: Celebrity being mature!

parts.note: a being is a person
to age is to mature

explanation.surface: A famous figure growing up.
explanation.definitionFit: A personage is an important or famous person.

clue.text: Reportedly uninterested, husband's left her in bed!

indicators.note: said aloud, the word for uninterested gives a sound written a different way

parts.note: bored means uninterested

indicators.note: left means gone, so the husband's letter goes from her

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A bored wife whose husband has walked out leaves her alone in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bed' is a flower bed, not a place to sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: A border is a strip of garden planted with flowers along an edge.

clue.text: Soldier's uniform

definitions.meaning: a member of the ... army, a professional soldier
steady and even, the same throughout

explanation.definitionFit: A regular is a full-time soldier, and regular also means even or unvarying.

clue.text: Act without restraint in high-scoring cricket match?

definitions.meaning: a run is a point in cricket, so a riot of runs makes a high score

explanation.definitionFit: To run riot is to behave wildly, and a match full of runs is a riot of runs.

clue.text: Muscles stretch — that's in theory

parts.note: abs are abdominal muscles
a tract is a stretch of land

explanation.surface: A gym session of muscle stretching, in principle.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstract means existing as an idea or concept, not concrete.

clue.text: Parade and exhibition substandard

parts.note: a show is an exhibition
off means not up to standard, as with food gone bad

explanation.surface: A procession and display that fell below par.
explanation.definitionFit: To show off is to parade or flaunt something.

clue.text: Where young lady returning with nothing on may take a dip?

definitions.text: Where young lady returning with nothing on may take a dip?

indicators.note: coming back, so the word for a young lady is read backwards

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl
O looks like zero, nothing
taken as written

explanation.surface: A skinny-dipping girl heads back for a swim.
explanation.definitionFit: A lagoon is a stretch of water separated from the sea, a place for a swim.

clue.text: Put forward in support of sterling

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
the pound is the British unit of currency

explanation.surface: Backing the British currency.
explanation.definitionFit: To propound is to put forward an idea for consideration.

clue.text: Miss a trick

definitions.meaning: to avoid or evade, as a blow

explanation.definitionFit: To dodge is to evade something, and a dodge is also a cunning ruse.

clue.text: Virginia not involved in crooked villainous trick

indicators.note: bent out of shape, so the remaining letters are rearranged
the state's letters play no part, so they are taken out

parts.note: VA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: A dishonest scheme in which a southern state played no part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not involved' removes V and A from villainous, leaving ILLINOUS, which 'crooked' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: An illusion is a deception, such as a conjuror's trick.

clue.text: Spoke for a tedious group of characters inside

indicators.note: a run of letters sits inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone talked for a dull crowd of people.
explanation.definitionFit: To have orated is to have given a speech.

clue.text: Storyteller's stirring rant and roar

indicators.note: stirring mixes things up, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A storyteller's rousing rants and bellows.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrator is the one who tells a story.

clue.text: Mischief-maker trapping insect, all round it's pathetic

indicators.note: the whole assembled piece is turned round to read the other way
the mischief-maker holds the insect within it

parts.note: an elf is a mischievous sprite
a bee is an insect

explanation.surface: An imp catches a bug, and everyone thinks it is sad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trapping' puts the insect inside the mischief-maker, and 'all round' turns that whole piece back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeble means weak and ineffective, pitiably poor.
